messages:
maria_cs: heads-up: Starling onboarding hit a burst of 429s during SDK warmup this morning, plus a few intermittent 401s. call in 10 to triage. logs below.
max_eng: thanks. are they using browser or server SDK? sample request + user-agent?
lia_onboard: theyre on Node SDK in a lambda pool, ~150 concurrent cold inits; preflight spiked.
maria_cs: sample curl from their eng:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" -H "User-Agent: starling-service/1.2.0" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
maria_cs: server logs show repeated 429 bodies `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":0.5}` and occasional 401 `invalid_token` when their refresh lambdas overlap.
max_eng: two suspects: (1) preflight/handshake fanout from cold starts, (2) ephemeral token refresh collision.
max_eng: quick mitigations: add jitter to refresh, short-LRU token cache per container, preflight coalescing (single promise).
lia_onboard: told them to add 300ms splay on startup, reduce parallel preflight to 10 per instance, and enable persistent http2 if runtime allows.
onboard-bot: deploy-check: observed 150 req/s from starling-org during 08:03-08:06 UTC, peak concurrency ~165, 429 rate 18%.
maria_cs: renewal risk = medium if not stable by EOD Tue. need eng playbook to hand to customer.
max_eng: drafting a short playbook:
- on 429 -> exponential backoff with cap 2s
- preflight coalesce: single preflight per container using shared promise
- token refresh: leader election per pool or add 100-200ms jitter
- if persistent 429s -> throttle client-side or request Dedicated trial
lia_onboard: CSM checklist to send to Starling:
1) add jitter to token refresh; elect leader for renewals
2) reduce parallel preflight to <=10 per container; use warm hooks
3) enable keepalive/http2 pooling on SDK layer
4) if 429s persist after client fixes -> CS to qualify Dedicated trial
maria_cs: max, can you paste a quick token-leader snippet?
max_eng: node example:
```
let refreshPromise = null;
async function getToken() {
  if (refreshPromise) return refreshPromise;
  refreshPromise = refreshToken();
  try { return await refreshPromise; } finally { refreshPromise = null; }
}
```
max_eng: also ask them to surface telemetry headers: X-Request-Id and X-CSM-Org so we can correlate.
lia_onboard: joining call now, will paste summary and action items after. maria, ill add renewal note and timelines in handoff doc. :calendar:
maria_cs: thanks  ping after call; ill update health rubric and flag sales for committed capacity if needed. :thumbsup:
max_eng: one more ask: if they can reproduce locally, have them run load with `concurrency=50` and `stagger=100ms` send traces. helps rule out infra spikes.
lia_onboard: call moving to quick-triage channel; will post summary here when were back.
